objective: One shared whole-body tracker checkpoint for all eleven tasks, without task-based policy/checkpoint routing or body-part policy composition
preserved_baseline: Frozen integrated V3 task-routed tracker; prior results and weights remain immutable
reference_pipeline: Keep frozen V3 generator and retarget outputs for a matched tracker comparison; task-specific retarget details disclosed separately from unified tracker
initial_training: 55 original development source references; 11 tasks x5commands; p0/s0; all clips and parameters sampled with one common observation/action interface
development_validation: 11tasks x p0 x2newnoises x5commands =110; used for architecture/training choices, not independent claims
final_test: 11tasks x4sharedtemplates x4newnoises x5commands =880; no final metrics inspected until one unified checkpoint is selected and hashed
selection: Rank shared checkpoints by macro semantic_E_all on development validation; failures/event failures cost1, otherwise clipped abs error/taskspan. Retain per-task completion, joint pass and monotonicity. Do not select different checkpoints per task. Require no task-based actor dispatch in inference.
baseline_evaluation: Old frozen routed tracker and selected unified tracker on identical fresh final references, same standing entry and physical failure definitions. Native actuator/physics differences disclosed.
transitions: Separate continuous-reference sequence tests with no simulator reset or actor reload between actions; report separately from single-task numeric benchmark. Do not claim arbitrary composition from sequential transitions.
development_iterations: May improve sampling, observation preview, common rewards or distillation using development/training only; record each variant before evaluation. Distillation is optional, not assumed successful.
